name: Cream Pie
source:
Cream Pie  A Sweet Visual Novel of Love and Dreams!

Welcome to Cream Pie, a heartwarming romantic visual novel where baking, friendship, and love blend together into one unforgettable story.
Step into the shoes of Ichigo, a passionate young baker attending a prestigious Baking Academy while working part-time at the cozy Cream Pie Bakery. Every decision you make shapes Ichigo’s journey and determines who captures his heart.

From classroom rivalries to late-night baking sessions, every day at Cream Pie is a new chance to mix passion, friendship, and romance. Will Ichigo rise to the top as a master baker or find the sweetest love of all?


[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.RMGameStudios.CreamPie]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
奶油派 一部关于爱与梦想的甜蜜视觉小说！

欢迎来到《奶油派》，这是一部温馨浪漫的视觉小说，其中烘焙、友谊和爱情融合成一个令人难忘的故事。
扮演一护的角色，一位充满热情的年轻面包师，就读于著名的烘焙学院，同时在舒适的奶油派面包店兼职。你做出的每一个决定都会塑造一护的旅程，并决定谁能俘获他的心。

从课堂竞争到深夜烘焙课程，Cream Pie的每一天都是融合激情、友谊和浪漫的新机会。一护会成为面包大师并找到最甜蜜的爱情吗？


[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.RMGameStudios.CreamPie]Google Play[/url]]
